name: The Russian Sleep Experiment
description: A widely-shared internet horror story, posted to the Creepypasta Wiki on 10 August 2010, framed as a declassified record of a Soviet experiment in which prisoners kept awake for 15 days by a stimulant gas descend into psychotic violence. It is fiction; investigations by Snopes and others have repeatedly confirmed there is no such Soviet experiment.

aliases.name: Orange Soda story
aliases.meaning: after the original Creepypasta Wiki author handle

origin: Internet-native phenomenon: originated on the Creepypasta Wiki and spread through English-language forums, Reddit, YouTube and Tumblr; subsequently translated into many languages.
